caption_proposed: \caption{\textbf{Vision--language agreement with sentence encoders falls with the evaluation size but stays close to stable at a fixed $k/m$ (Conjecture~\ref{conj:scale}), and deeper vision features raise its level.} (a)~Class medians at $k=10$ as in Figure~\ref{fig:exp-neighbors}a, with sentence-encoder pairs as thin lines. (b)~Sums of the elasticities in $k$ and $m$ on $k\in\{10,100\}$, with group medians as bars and the preregistered tolerance in grey. (c)~Medians at $k=10$ with the middle (open) or last (filled) vision layer, for sentence encoders (squares) and language models (circles); the star marks the value of \citet{schnaus2026rosetta} for DINOv2-B and MPNet at equal $k/m$ (exploratory).}
